newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian futures end lower ahead of long weekend.
newsitem.headline: Italian futures end lower ahead of long weekend.

text.p: 1730 GMT - Italian bond futures slipped back in afternoon trading to end lower in line with other European bond markets and ahead of a long weekend in Italy. Italian financial markets are closed for Liberation Day on Friday. Dealers say markets are a little nervous ahead of Italian local elections on Sunday and a weekend G7 meeting in Washington. * Futures:JunLIF -59bps at 126.93. * Lira:largely steady at 995.15/5.50 per mark
